min_stay.season: Memorial Day, Independence Day and Labor Day weekends (2027 rule)

values.note: Primitive sites reserved site-specific on Kansas's ReserveAmerica site (campitks.gov); self-registration is also allowed. 2027 holiday minimum: 3 nights over Memorial Day, July 4th and Labor Day weekends. Up to 14 consecutive nights; a 14-day extension needs the park manager's written permission, and a five-day absence is required before camping again.
